title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.16

topic.reason: Neue KI-Modelle, Funktionen, Benchmarks (Treffer: model, qwen, llama)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.16): ## Ripple Preview [Ripple Preview](https://ollama.com/library/ripple-preview) from Ricursive Intelligence is a 65B dense model built for agentic coding. ```sh ollama run ripple-preview ``` ## What's Changed - Qwen3.8 Flash Next uses about 27 GiB less memory on Apple silicon - `ollama launch claude` always routes Claude Code to the selected model - `ollama launch` explains when a cloud model has been retired - `/v1/responses` respects `truncation` and no longer silently truncates by default - `/v1/models` returns an empty list instead of `null` when no models are installed - CUDA 13.5 support for Windows on ARM - Updated llama.cpp **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.15...v0.40.16
